import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Define the target schema columns and their types
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Data types for enforcing target schema
    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # Nullable integer
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # Load all source dataframes into a list
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype=str)  # Read all as string first to avoid dtype issues
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Convert columns to target dtypes carefully, handling missing or malformed data
    # For integer columns, convert with errors='coerce' then to Int64 (nullable int)
    int_columns = ['tripduration', 'start station id', 'end station id', 'bikeid', 'birth year', 'gender']
    float_columns = ['start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude']
    string_columns = ['starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station name', 'end station name', 'usertype']

    # Convert integer columns
    for col in int_columns:
        if col in combined_df.columns:
            combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        else:
            # If missing, create column with NA
            combined_df[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA]*len(combined_df), dtype='Int64')

    # Convert float columns
    for col in float_columns:
        if col in combined_df.columns:
            combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('float64')
        else:
            combined_df[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA]*len(combined_df), dtype='float64')

    # Convert string columns
    for col in string_columns:
        if col in combined_df.columns:
            combined_df[col] = combined_df[col].astype('string')
        else:
            combined_df[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA]*len(combined_df), dtype='string')

    # Ensure all target columns exist in the dataframe (add missing columns with NA)
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in combined_df.columns:
            combined_df[col] = pd.NA

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

    # For tripduration, convert to int (non-nullable) by filling NA with 0 or dropping rows with NA
    # Since tripduration is critical, drop rows with NA in tripduration
    combined_df = combined_df.dropna(subset=['tripduration'])
    combined_df['tripduration'] = combined_df['tripduration'].astype(int)

    # For starttime and stoptime, ensure string type and fill NA with empty string if any
    combined_df['starttime'] = combined_df['starttime'].fillna('')
    combined_df['stoptime'] = combined_df['stoptime'].fillna('')

    # For usertype, fill NA with 'Unknown'
    combined_df['usertype'] = combined_df['usertype'].fillna('Unknown')

    # For gender and birth year, keep as nullable Int64 (no fill)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
